caption.scope: Two-compartment glucose distribution from Hovorka et al. (Physiol Meas 25:905-920, 2004), extended with a direct, glucose-dependent contraction sink from Q1: plasma glucose receives U_G and EGP, exchanges with Q2 through x1-driven transport and k12 backflow, and supplies F01c, F_R and U_ex. Q2 loses glucose through x2-driven disposal, while delayed exercise sensitivity changes the upstream EC50 of x1 and x2; arrow equations show requested rates, with simultaneous outgoing fluxes from each glucose pool proportionally limited to its available mass per time step before updating either pool.
